root_cause_hypothesis: The invoice was received and entered into the system before the corresponding goods or services were formally confirmed as received. Since a PO exists and the invoice is new, the system is waiting for a Goods Receipt Note (GRN) to complete the three-way match.
recommended_action: Contact the PO owner/requestor to confirm receipt of goods/services and ask them to create the GRN in the system.
communication_draft:
Dear HP Enterprise Inc. Accounts Team,

We are writing to you regarding a discrepancy with a recent invoice.

Invoice ID: 5
PO Number: PO-88888
Invoice Amount: $15500.00

We are unable to process this invoice for payment as our system indicates that the goods for the corresponding purchase order, PO-88888, have not yet been received. Therefore, a Goods Received Note (GRN) has not been generated.

Could you please investigate the delivery status of this order? If the goods have been dispatched, please provide the proof of delivery so we can confirm receipt. Otherwise, please issue a credit note against invoice 5 and re-invoice only after the goods have been successfully delivered.

We kindly request an update on this matter within 5 business days to ensure timely resolution.

Thank you for your cooperation.

Kind regards,

Accounts Payable Team

root_cause_hypothesis: The invoice has been matched to a purchase order, but the system has not yet registered a corresponding Goods Receipt Note (GRN). This prevents the three-way match from completing, likely because the receiving department has not yet processed the delivery.
recommended_action: Contact the PO owner or receiving department to confirm delivery and request they raise the Goods Receipt Note (GRN).

Dear Staples Business Advantage,

We are writing in reference to Invoice #3 for $11,250.00, associated with our Purchase Order PO-45002.

We are currently unable to process this invoice for payment as our records indicate that the goods for this order have not yet been received.

To resolve this discrepancy, please provide the proof of delivery documentation for this shipment. If the goods were not delivered, please issue a credit note to cancel this invoice. Payment is on hold pending the resolution of this query.

We kindly request your response within the next 5 business days.

Thank you for your prompt assistance.

Best regards,

Accounts Payable Team
